entry.p: If both lane markings are detected, or if a preceding vehicle within the recognized lanes is detected, and the vehicle speed is below the operating speed, the system assists with steering to help keep the vehicle centered in the lane. In this case, the green indicator () appears on the cluster.

li.p: When both lanes are detected: 0–170 km/h (105 mph)
When a preceding vehicle is detected: 0–75 km/h (45 mph)

note.p: When the steering wheel is not assisted, the white () indicator light blinks and change to gray.
